Priya - Customer Success: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands — can folks drop 1 line about why we won or lost with the customers we discussed? we'll triage asks.
Leah - Product: Sure. I'll start: Win with Acme — reliable latency + clear cost model won the POC. They called out console observability as a differentiator.
Samir - Sales: Loss to BigCorp — they wanted FIPS/C2 compliance and a private installation option; our Dedicated SLA looked okay but procurement wanted certs.
Maya - GTM: Acme also loved the onboarding templates and sample prompts — made evaluation fast.
Devon - Eng: For BigCorp, we hit a blocker: their sequences are very long, our default batching introduced tail latency spikes. We prototyped a prefix-cache fix but need gated rollout.
Priya - Customer Success: From CS checklists: wins = quick start, transparent perf. Loss patterns = security certifications, dedicated deployment docs, and model explainability requests.
Tom - CEO: Thanks. Top asks we should prioritize: 1) battlecard for sales on compliance gaps + mitigation; 2) a clear Dedicated onboarding checklist; 3) a short engineering playbook for long-sequence customers. @Leah — can product own 1 and 2?
Leah - Product: I can own the battlecard and checklist. Will need one SME from Eng and one from Sales to review. Samir can you nominate someone?
Samir - Sales: I'll slot Priya and Nate (AE) to review. Also request a short one-page risk statement for Sales to attach to RFPs.
Devon - Eng: I'll own the engineering playbook for long sequences. ETA end of next week if no major blockers. Will stub in a `runbook.md` and a short code snippet for prefix caching.
Priya - Customer Success: I'll compile a short list of customers affected and their asks — will post it here by EOD.
Maya - GTM: Suggest we also create a 1-pager "why we win" for marketing targeting AI-native startups — quick bullets: cost predictability, unified runtime, rollout controls.
Tom - CEO: Good. Prioritize compliance/battlecard first — losing enterprise deals is high impact. Leah + Samir + Priya, sync and get a draft by Tue.
Leah - Product: Ack. I'll create a doc and ping reviewers. Link will be in this thread: <https://docs.redwood.ai/internal/battlecards/customer-compliance-draft>
Devon - Eng: Quick note: for the prefix cache snippet I'll use this pattern:
```
# pseudocode
if seq_len > 1024:
  use_prefix_cache()
else:
  default_batch()
```
Priya - Customer Success: Posted the customer list: Acme (won), BigCorp (lost), NovaApps (won on cost), FinX (lost on encryption ask). Details in doc: <https://docs.redwood.ai/internal/post-allhands-customer-list>
Tom - CEO: Thanks team. Action items captured: Leah = battlecard + checklist, Devon = long-seq playbook, Priya = customer list + follow-ups, Samir = AE reviewers, Maya = marketing 1-pager. Let's reconvene after drafts are in. :thumbsup:
